name: Ashbringer
entries: Infused with the Holy Light and forged by King Magni Bronzebeard on the Great Anvil of Ironforge, Ashbringer was once the pride and joy of the knightly Mograine family. But when the traitorous Renault Mograine used the sword to kill his father, it became corrupted. The sword was claimed by the Scourge until Renault's brother, Darion Mograine, betrayed the Lich King and delivered the weapon to Tirion Fordring—an act of heroism that cleansed Ashbringer of its corruption and restored the sword to its rightful form.

entries.name: Magic Weapon
entries: You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It deals an extra {@damage 1d10} Fire damage on a hit, or an extra {@damage 3d10} Fire damage if the target is Undead.

entries.name: Changing States
entries: When first encountered, Ashbringer is in either its {@item Ashbringer (True State)|WoW|True State} or its {@item Corrupted Ashbringer|WoW|Corrupted State}. At the DM's discretion, Ashbringer changes into its Corrupted State if its wielder uses it to commit an act of legendary wickedness; it changes into its True State if its wielder uses it to commit an act of legendary heroism. Ashbringer's current state grants you one of the following benefits:

entries.name: Steal Life (Corrupted State Only)
entries: Whenever you use Ashbringer to reduce a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you gain 20 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

entries.name: Wake of Ashes (True State Only)
entries: Whenever you use Ashbringer to reduce a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you can make its corpse explode into a cloud of smoldering ash. Each creature of your choice in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Sentience
entries: Ashbringer is a sentient weapon with an Intelligence of 14, a Wisdom of 17, and a Charisma of 17. It is Lawful Good in its True State or Lawful Evil in its Corrupted State. It has hearing and {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 120 feet.
The weapon communicates telepathically with its wielder and speaks Common and Dwarven.

entries.name: Personality
entries: Ashbringer's voice sounds like faint, intermittent whispers. In its True State, Ashbringer seeks to serve the forces of the Light and reduce the unholy to ash. In its Corrupted State, Ashbringer wants to undermine faith in the Light and destroy the righteous. Conflict arises if the wielder doesn't share the goals of Ashbringer's current state.

entries.name: Random Properties
entries: Ashbringer has the following random properties:

items: 1 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|XDMG|minor beneficial} property
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Major Beneficial Properties|XDMG|major beneficial} property
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|XDMG|minor detrimental} property

entries.name: Destroying Ashbringer
entries: Ashbringer can be destroyed only by its creator, Magni Bronzebeard. The weapon will shatter when he strikes it against the Great Anvil of Ironforge.

items.name: Sentience
entries: Ashbringer is a sentient weapon with an Intelligence of 14, a Wisdom of 17, and a Charisma of 17. It is Lawful Good in its True State. It has hearing and {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 120 feet.
The weapon communicates telepathically with its wielder and speaks Common and Dwarven.

items.name: Personality
entries: Ashbringer's voice sounds like faint, intermittent whispers. In its True State, Ashbringer seeks to serve the forces of the Light and reduce the unholy to ash. Conflict arises if the wielder doesn't share the goals of Ashbringer's current state.

name: Aviana's Feather
entries: While attuned to this golden feather, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to sprout a pair of glowing, golden wings from your back. The wings give you a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of 80 feet, and any creature that makes an {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} against you when you fly out of its reach has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the attack roll. If you fall while you have the wings, you descend at a rate of 60 feet per round until you land.
The wings last until you end the effect early as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action or until your {@variantrule Attunement|XPHB} ends. If you are aloft when the wings disappear, you fall.

name: Cenarion War Hippogryph
entries: Use the {@creature Hippogriff|XMM} stat block.

{@b Prerequisite:} Renown 50+ with the {@book Cenarion Circle|WoW|4|Cenarion Circle Renown Perks}. If your Renown Score with the Cenarion Circle falls below 50, your mount no longer obeys your commands.

items.name: Sentience
entries: Ashbringer is a sentient weapon with an Intelligence of 14, a Wisdom of 17, and a Charisma of 17. It is Lawful Evil in its Corrupted State. It has hearing and {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 120 feet.
The weapon communicates telepathically with its wielder and speaks Common and Dwarven.

items.name: Personality
entries: Ashbringer's voice sounds like faint, intermittent whispers. In its Corrupted State, Ashbringer wants to undermine faith in the Light and destroy the righteous. Conflict arises if the wielder doesn't share the goals of Ashbringer's current state.

name: Crown of the Ogre King
entries: While wearing this crown, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to release a powerful belch that can be heard up to 300 feet away. Each creature in a 20-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} originating from you makes a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature is pushed up to 20 feet away from you and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Cursed
entries: This item is cursed. Attuning to it curses you until you are targeted by a {@spell Remove Curse|XPHB} spell or similar magic. Removing the crown fails to end the curse on you. While cursed, you are far hungrier than normal. You lose all your table manners, and your daily food requirement triples.

name: Defias Leather
entries: Elite members of the Defias Brotherhood wear this armor to honor the faction's stonemason founders. While wearing the armor, you gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Mason's Camouflage
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks made to hide behind stone objects and structures.

entries.name: Meld into Stone
entries: You can cast {@spell Meld into Stone|XPHB} from the armor. Once the armor has been used to cast this spell, it can't be used to cast it again until the next dawn.

name: Dire Wolf
entries: Use the {@creature Dire Wolf|XMM} stat block.
{@b Prerequisite:} Renown 10+ with {@book Orgrimmar|WoW|4|Orgrimmar Renown Perks}.

name: Doomhammer
entries: Long ago on the world of Draenor, an orc named Gelnar set out to fashion a weapon that would empower his people against their ogre foes. He forged a fearsome hammer in the heat of an elemental pool of lava. Dubbed Doomhammer, this weapon was passed down through generations of Blackrock orcs. An ancient prophecy foretold that possession of the hammer would someday leave the Blackrock lineage; this prophecy came true when {@creature Thrall|WoW}, an orc shaman, proved himself the weapon's worthy wielder.

entries.name: Magic Weapon
entries: You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It deals an extra {@damage 1d8} Lightning damage on a hit.

entries.name: Gelnar's Gifts
entries: While holding Doomhammer, you gain the following benefits:

items.name: Doom Winds
entries: Your fury carries the unbridled momentum of a windstorm. While your {@classFeature Rage|Barbarian|XPHB|1|XPHB} is active, your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is doubled, and you can take an extra {@action Attack|XPHB} action (one attack only) on each of your turns.

items.name: Lava Stride
entries: You take no damage from molten lava and can walk across it as if it were solid ground.

items.name: Lightning Rod
entries: When a creature you can see within 60 feet of you would take Lightning damage, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to reduce the damage to 0.

items.name: Storm's Passage
entries: You can cast {@spell Wind Walk|XPHB} from this weapon. Once the weapon has been used to cast this spell, it can't be used to cast it again until the next dawn.

entries.name: Random Properties
entries: Doomhammer has the following random properties:

items: 2 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|XDMG|minor beneficial} properties
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Major Beneficial Properties|XDMG|major beneficial} property
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|XDMG|minor detrimental} property

entries.name: Destroying Doomhammer
entries: To destroy Doomhammer, a descendant of Gelnar must hurl the weapon into the eye of a storm in Outland, the remnants of the destroyed world of Draenor.

name: Elekk
entries: Use the {@creature Giant Goat|XMM} stat block.
{@b Prerequisite:} Renown 10+ with the {@book Exodar|WoW|4|Exodar Renown Perks}.

name: Experimental Goblin Jetpack
entries: While wearing this pack, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to fire up its jets. The jets remain active for 1 hour or until you end the effect early as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action. The jets give you a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of 60 feet. If you are aloft when the jets become inactive, you fall. When the jets stop, you can't use them again for {@dice 1d12} hours.

name: Figurine of Wondrous Power (Jeweled Panther)
entries: A {@item Figurine of Wondrous Power|XDMG} is a statuette small enough to fit in a pocket. If you take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to throw the figurine to a point on the ground within 60 feet of yourself, the figurine becomes a living creature specified in the figurine's description below. If the space where the creature would appear is occupied by other creatures or objects, or if there isn't enough space for the creature, the figurine doesn't become a creature.

The creature is {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|XPHB|Friendly} to you and your allies. It understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count. If you issue no commands, the creature defends itself but takes no other actions.

The creature exists for a duration specific to each figurine. At the end of the duration, the creature reverts to its figurine form. It reverts to a figurine early if its creature form drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or if you take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action while touching the creature to make it revert to figurine form. When the creature becomes a figurine again, its property can't be used again until a certain amount of time has passed, as specified below.

entries.name: Jeweled Panther (Rare)
entries: This statuette is of a panther made from jade, onyx, ruby, sapphire, or sunstone. It can become a Large {@creature Panther|XMM} with a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of 30 feet for up to 12 hours and can be ridden as a mount. Once it has been used, it can't be used again until 2 days have passed.

name: Flask of the Titans
entries: When you drink this potion, your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum and current {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} increase by 30 for 1 hour.
The golden liquid in this flask tastes like honey and gleams with the light of dawn.

name: Flying Machine
entries: A small gyrocopter with a rotor on top, two side-mounted engines, and skis as landing gear.
{#itemEntry Powered Vehicles|WoW}
A Flying Machine can't be purchased; it must be made by a character with expert {@book engineering|WoW|3|Engineering}. Crafting the machine requires 2,000 GP of resources.

name: Frostmourne
entries: Runes of domination adorn this icy mourneblade. The Jailer—one of the rulers of the Shadowlands—originally sought to use Frostmourne to subjugate Azeroth, and that cruel intention forever lingers in the form of a prophecy: "Whosoever takes up this blade shall wield power eternal. Just as the blade rends flesh, so must power scar the spirit." Arthas Menethil was the first to discover the prophecy's true meaning when he lost his soul by wielding the sword, ultimately becoming the {@creature Lich King Arthas|WoW|Lich King}.

entries.name: Magic Weapon
entries: You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It deals an extra {@damage 2d12} Cold damage on a hit. Whenever you use Frostmourne to reduce a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, the creature dies, and its soul is trapped in the sword. The target can't be raised from the dead until Frostmourne is destroyed.

entries.name: Pawn of the Lich King
entries: While you're attuned to Frostmourne, the Lich King can see through your eyes, hear through your ears, and communicate with you telepathically over any distance, even across planes.

entries.name: Prophecy of Frostmourne
entries: When you attune to Frostmourne, your creature type becomes Undead, and your alignment becomes Neutral Evil. These changes remain even if your {@variantrule Attunement|XPHB} ends.

entries.name: Twisted Aura
entries: If you are a Paladin, you also gain the following benefits while attuned to Frostmourne:

items.name: Marshal Undead
entries: Undead creatures of your choice (excluding you) in your {@classFeature Aura of Protection|Paladin|XPHB|6|XPHB} have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and saving throws.

items.name: Numb to Cold
entries: Allies in your {@classFeature Aura of Protection|Paladin|XPHB|6|XPHB} have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Cold damage.

entries.name: Random Properties
entries: Frostmourne has the following random properties:

items: 1 {@table Artifact Properties; Major Beneficial Properties|XDMG|major beneficial} property
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|XDMG|minor detrimental} property
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Major Detrimental Properties|XDMG|major detrimental} property

entries.name: Destroying Frostmourne
entries: Frostmourne shatters if its wielder is slain by the legendary sword {@item Ashbringer|WoW}. Only the Runecarver, who forged the weapon at the Jailer's command, can reforge Frostmourne from the resulting fragments.

name: Fuel
entries: This Fuel powers a vehicle for 8 hours of travel. Characters can use the {@book alchemy|WoW|3|Alchemy} profession to craft Fuel.

name: Giant Goat
entries: Use the {@creature Giant Goat|XMM} stat block.
{@b Prerequisite:} Renown 10+ with {@book Ironforge|WoW|4|Ironforge Renown Perks}.

name: Giant Hyena
entries: Use the {@creature Giant Hyena|XMM} stat block.
{@b Prerequisite:} Renown 10+ with {@book Steamwheedle Cartel|WoW|4|Steamwheedle Cartel}.

name: Giant Seahorse
entries: Use the {@creature Giant Seahorse|XMM} stat block.

name: Gnomeregan Engineering Device
entries: {@i Prerequisite: Renown 25+ with Gnomeregan}

You can request a complicated engineering device from the leaders of Gnomeregan before you undertake a quest on their behalf. You receive a mechanical device that functions as a {@item Wand of Wonder|XDMG}, but it can't regain charges, and it explodes dramatically but harmlessly when its last charge is expended. The device doesn't require Attunement, but it functions only for you.

name: Goblin Jumper Cables
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can attach these cables to a dead creature and attempt to return the creature to life. Make a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana|XPHB}) check using {@item Tinker's Tools|XPHB}. On a successful check, the creature revives with 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} as long as the creature has been dead no longer than 1 minute and didn't die of old age. On a failed check, you take {@damage 2d6} Lightning damage.
Once used, a set of Goblin Jumper Cables can't be used again until the next dawn.

name: Goblin Trike
entries: A three-wheeled motor vehicle with luxurious wood paneling.
{#itemEntry Powered Vehicles|WoW}
{@b Prerequisite:} Renown 10+ with any goblin cartel.

name: Gryphon
entries: Use the {@creature Griffon|XMM} stat block.
{@b Prerequisite:} Renown 25+ with the {@book Alliance|WoW|4|Alliance Renown Perks}.

name: Hawkstrider
entries: Use the {@creature Axe Beak|XMM} stat block.
{@b Prerequisite:} Renown 10+ with {@book Silvermoon City|WoW|4|Silvermoon City Renown Perks}.

name: Hearthstone
entries: A Hearthstone teleports you to a predetermined location—usually an inn. Activating the stone takes 1 minute and a {@action Magic|XPHB} action. You appear in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of the destination you previously set.

While you are at an inn (or other locations at the DM's discretion), you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to set that location as the destination for your Hearthstone's teleportation. That location becomes your destination until you change it.
One Hearthstone doesn't count against the number of magic items you can have {@variantrule Attunement|XPHB} to.

name: Helm of Domination
entries: This ornate helm is infused with the power of domination—a form of runic magic intended to utterly suppress the will of another being. The helm (along with its companion Artifact, {@item Frostmourne|WoW}) allowed its wearers—three successive Lich Kings—to rule the Scourge.

entries.name: Attuning to the Helm
entries: When you attune to the helm, make a {@dc 18} Charisma saving throw. On a successful save, you take {@damage 10d6} Psychic damage. On a failed save, your soul merges with the Lich King, who then takes control of your body like a puppet, and you become an NPC under the DM's control.
While attuned to the helm, you are unwilling to part with the helm, wearing it at all times, and you can't voluntarily end your {@variantrule Attunement|XPHB} to the helm.

entries.name: Properties of the Helm
entries: While attuned to the helm, your alignment is Neutral Evil, and you gain the following benefits:

items.name: Command the Scourge
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can send a psychic command to each Undead that is part of the Scourge. Make an ability check using your spellcasting ability ({@dc 20}). On a successful check, you can issue a general command to the Undead Scourge, such as "attack any creature you come across" or "guard my stronghold," or you can issue a command to a specific member of the Scourge, such as "deliver a plague to Stormwind." Whether or not you succeed, this property of the helm can't be used again until the next dawn.

items.name: Truesight
entries: You have {@sense Truesight|XPHB} with a range of 120 feet.

items.name: Spellcasting
entries: The helm has 8 charges and regains {@dice 1d4 + 4} expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the helm, you can cast one of the spells on the following table from it (save {@dc 18}). The table indicates how many charges you must expend to cast the spell.

entries.name: Random Properties
entries: The Helm of Domination has the following random properties:

items: 1 {@table Artifact Properties; Major Beneficial Properties|XDMG|major beneficial} property
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|XDMG|minor detrimental} property
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Major Detrimental Properties|XDMG|major detrimental} property

entries.name: Destroying the Helm of Domination
entries: The helm is shattered if struck by a blade forged in the Shadowlands. Only the Runecarver, who originally forged the helm, can reforge it from the fragments.

name: Judgment Armor
entries: While wearing this armor, you are under the effects of the {@spell Detect Evil and Good|XPHB} and {@spell Protection from Evil and Good|XPHB} spells (no {@status Concentration|XPHB} required). If you are a Paladin, the effects of {@spell Protection from Evil and Good|XPHB} extend to creatures of your choice in your {@classFeature Aura of Protection|Paladin|XPHB|6|XPHB}.

name: Kodo
entries: Use the {@creature Giant Lizard|XMM} stat block.
{@b Prerequisite:} Renown 10+ with {@book Thunder Bluff|WoW|4|Thunder Bluff Renown Perks}.

name: Life-Staff of the Web Lair
entries: This staff has 8 charges.

entries.name: Arachnid's Grace
entries: While attuned to the staff, you can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and along ceilings without using your hands. You also gain a {@variantrule Climb Speed|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}. You ignore movement restrictions caused by webs, and you know the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

entries.name: Web
entries: While holding the staff, you can expend 1 charge to cast {@spell Web|XPHB} (save {@dc 18}) from it.

entries.name: Vampiric Silk
entries: While holding the staff, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} and expend 1 charge to have a creature in the area of your {@spell Web|XPHB} spell make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw. (The creature makes the save with {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} if it has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition from the webbing.) The creature takes {@damage 4d10} Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Either way, you regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to half the damage dealt.

entries.name: Regaining Charges
entries: The staff regains {@dice 1d6 + 2} expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll {@dice 1d20}. On a 1, the staff dissolves into a swarm of harmless spiders and is destroyed.

name: Mechano-Hog
entries: A powerful motorcycle with an optional sidecar, made by the Horde.
{#itemEntry Powered Vehicles|WoW}
{@b Prerequisite:} Renown 10+ with the {@book Horde|WoW|4|Horde Renown Perks}.

name: Mechanostrider
entries: Use the {@creature Mechanostrider|WoW} stat block.
{@b Prerequisite:} Renown 10+ with {@book Gnomeregan|WoW|4|Gnomeregan Renown Perks}.

name: Mekgineer's Chopper
entries: A powerful motorcycle with an optional sidecar, made by the Alliance.
{#itemEntry Powered Vehicles|WoW}
{@b Prerequisite:} Renown 10+ with the {@book Alliance|WoW|4|Alliance Renown Perks}.

name: Nightsaber
entries: Use the {@creature Tiger|XMM} stat block.
{@b Prerequisite:} Renown 10+ with {@book Darnassus|WoW|4|Darnassus Renown Perks}.

name: Noggenfogger Elixir
entries: Noggenfogger Elixir is an unpredictable potion invented by Marin Noggenfogger, the trade prince of the Steamwheedle Cartel. It is highly coveted by adventurers (particularly goblins), despite or perhaps because of its unpredictable effects. When you drink this potion, roll {@dice 1d6}: On a 1-2, you take on a skeletal appearance for {@dice 1d4} hours, during which time you don't need to breathe. (Not breathing doesn't give you {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} levels.) On a 3-4, you gain the Reduce effect of the {@spell Enlarge/Reduce|XPHB} spell for {@dice 1d4} hours (no {@status Concentration|XPHB} required). On a 5-6, your rate of descent while falling slows to 60 feet per round for 10 minutes. During that time, you take no damage from falling.
Drinking multiple Noggenfogger Elixirs doesn't require you to roll on the {@table Mixing Potions; Potion Miscibility|XDMG|Potion Miscibility} table in the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|XDMG}.
This green potion is oily in the mouth.

name: Pandarian Dragon Turtle
entries: Use the {@creature Pandarian Dragon Turtle|WoW} stat block.
{@b Prerequisite:} Renown 10+ with the {@book Huojin|WoW|4|Huojin Renown Perks} or the {@book Tushui|WoW|4|Tushui Renown Perks}.

name: Philosopher's Stone
entries: A Philosopher's Stone is a powerful reagent used in alchemy, and it can be effectively used only by the alchemist who created it. While you carry it, you gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Spellcasting Focus
entries: You can use your Philosopher's Stone as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} for your spells.

entries.name: Transmute Resources
entries: If you spend 1 hour (which can be concurrent with a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}) with your Philosopher's Stone and crafting resources of a single kind (fish, gems, herbs, ores or stones, leather or hide, or cloth), you can magically transmute the resources into resources of a different kind but the same value. Thus, you can convert 100 GP worth of herbs into 100 GP worth of ore or vice versa, or change 500 GP of mithril (a common ore) into 500 GP of truesilver (a rare ore).

entries.name: Mixology
entries: When you roll a die to determine the effect of a potion you drink (including the result of mixing potions), you can roll the die twice and choose either result. If a potion you drink has a duration, that duration is doubled.

name: Potion of Mana
entries: You regain one expended level 1 spell slot when you drink this potion.
The potion's blue liquid glows with an inner light.

name: Potion of Mana (Greater)
entries: You regain one expended level 1-3 spell slot when you drink this potion. You choose the spell slot you regain.
The potion's blue liquid glows with an inner light.

name: Potion of Mana (Superior)
entries: You regain one expended level 1-5 spell slot when you drink this potion. You choose the spell slot you regain.
The potion's blue liquid glows with an inner light.

name: Potion of Rejuvenation
entries: You regain {@dice 3d4 + 3} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and one expended level 1 spell slot when you drink this potion.
The potion's magenta liquid glows faintly from within.

name: Potion of Rejuvenation (Greater)
entries: You regain {@dice 6d4 + 6} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and one expended level 1-3 spell slot when you drink this potion. You choose the spell slot you regain.
The potion's magenta liquid glows faintly from within.

name: Potion of Rejuvenation (Superior)
entries: You regain {@dice 9d4 + 9} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and one expended level 1-5 spell slot when you drink this potion. You choose the spell slot you regain.
The potion's magenta liquid glows faintly from within.

name: Raptor
entries: Use the {@creature Allosaurus|XMM} stat block.
{@b Prerequisite:} Renown 10+ with the {@book Darkspear Tribe|WoW|4|Darkspear Tribe Renown Perks}.

name: Rod of the Sleepwalker
entries: This rod puts creatures into a suggestible, sleepwalking state. You can cast {@spell Dominate Monster|XPHB} (save {@dc 17}) from this rod, with the following modifications:

entries.name: Duration
entries: The spell's duration is {@status Concentration|XPHB}, up to 8 hours.

entries.name: Immunity
entries: Creatures that don't sleep, such as elves, or that have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} condition automatically succeed on the save.

entries.name: Memory
entries: An affected creature remembers nothing from the spell's duration once the spell ends.
Once the rod has been used to cast the spell in this way, it can't be used to do so again until the next dawn.

name: Shadowfang
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

entries.name: Mark of the Worgen
entries: In most circumstances, the weapon appears unremarkable. But under the night sky, ragged fur and sharp fangs sprout around the sword's cross guard. While transformed in this way, Shadowfang deals an extra {@damage 2d6} Necrotic damage on a hit. The weapon returns to normal at dawn or if it is brought indoors.

name: Shalamayne
entries: When dragon magic split King Varian Wrynn into two versions of himself, one of his selves wielded the night elven blade {@item Shalamayne (Shalla'tor)|WoW|Shalla'tor}, while the other wielded the night elven blade {@item Shalamayne (Ellemayne)|WoW|Ellemayne}. Varian eventually merged his twin selves back into one whole. In doing so, he inadvertently fused the blades into a new weapon called Shalamayne.

The Jailer, one of the rulers of the Shadowlands, once stole and reforged Shalamayne into a mourneblade called Kingsmourne. But Varian's son, Anduin Wrynn, later restored Shalamayne to its rightful form. Anduin is the sword's last known wielder.

entries.name: Magic Weapon
entries: You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It deals an extra {@damage 2d12} Force damage on a hit.

entries.name: Dual Mastery
entries: If you have the Weapon Mastery feature and choose {@item Greatsword|XPHB} as one of your mastered weapons, you can use both the {@itemMastery Graze|XPHB} and {@itemMastery Sap|XPHB} mastery properties at once while wielding Shalamayne.

entries.name: Splitting and Reuniting the Sword
entries: While holding Shalamayne, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to end your {@variantrule Attunement|XPHB} to the weapon and split it into two magic swords: {@item Shalamayne (Shalla'tor)|WoW|Shalla'tor} and {@item Shalamayne (Ellemayne)|WoW|Ellemayne}. Each is a {@item +3 Longsword|XDMG} with the {@itemProperty F|XPHB|Finesse} and {@itemProperty L|XPHB|Light} properties. A creature who holds both swords can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to rejoin them into Shalamayne, attuning to the weapon instantly.

entries.name: Random Properties
entries: Shalamayne has the following random properties:

items: 2 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|XDMG|minor beneficial} properties
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Major Beneficial Properties|XDMG|major beneficial} property

entries.name: Destroying Shalamayne
entries: One can destroy Shalamayne by splitting it into Shalla'tor and Ellemayne, then burying one or both swords at the roots of a World Tree in the Emerald Dream. After one year, the buried swords dissolve into the soil.

items.name: Magic Weapon
entries: You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

name: Staff of Light and Shadow
entries: This staff has two forms: a shadowy state known as {@item Staff of Light and Shadow (Anathema)|WoW|Anathema} and a holy state known as {@item Staff of Light and Shadow (Benediction)|WoW|Benediction}. While attuned to the staff, you can switch the staff from one state to the other at dawn.

entries.name: Anathema
entries: As Anathema, the staff grants the following benefits:

items.name: Necrotic Resistance
entries: While attuned to the staff, you have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Necrotic damage.

items.name: Shadow Mana
entries: While you're holding the staff, when you cast a {@filter level 1-5 spell|spells|level=1;2;3;4;5|school=N} from the Necromancy school that would expend a spell slot, you can roll {@dice 1d6}. If the number on the die exceeds the spell's level, the spell slot isn't expended.

entries.name: Benediction
entries: As Benediction, the staff grants the following benefits:

items.name: Radiant Resistance
entries: While attuned to the staff, you have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Radiant {@variantrule Damage|XPHB}.

items.name: Light-Blessed Healing
entries: While you're holding the staff, when you cast a spell that would restore {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} to a creature, you can treat the spell as if it had been cast using a spell slot of 1 level higher.

name: Sulfuras, Hand of Ragnaros
entries: The elementium {@item Maul|XPHB} Sulfuras is the weapon of {@creature Ragnaros|WoW}, the Elemental Lord of Fire. In the beginning, the four elemental lords warred against one another for dominance over the nascent Azeroth. While the other elemental lords fought with mastery of their own elements, Ragnaros used Sulfuras to turn their elements against them, boiling seas, choking the skies with smoke and embers, and turning mountains into erupting volcanoes.

entries.name: Magic Weapon
entries: You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. A creature hit by this weapon takes an extra {@damage 1d10} Fire damage and starts {@hazard burning|XPHB}, taking {@damage 1d10} Fire damage at the start of each of its turns instead of the normal burning damage.

entries.name: Ignite the Elements
entries: While holding this weapon, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to produce one of the following effects. Once an effect has been used, that effect can't be used again until the next dawn:

items.name: Boiling Point
entries: You cause any container or body of water within 1 mile of you to boil for 1 minute. A creature that enters the boiling water or starts its turn there takes {@damage 2d10} Fire damage.

items.name: Embersmoke
entries: You cast {@spell Incendiary Cloud|XPHB} (save {@dc 18}) from the weapon.

items.name: Eruption
entries: You make lava erupt in a 10-foot-radius, 60-foot-high {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} centered on a point on the ground you can see within 120 feet. Each creature in that area makes a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 9d10} Fire damage plus {@damage 9d10} Bludgeoning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Random Properties
entries: Sulfuras has the following random properties:

items: 1 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|XDMG|minor beneficial} property
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Major Beneficial Properties|XDMG|major beneficial} property
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|XDMG|minor detrimental} property
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Major Detrimental Properties|XDMG|major detrimental} property

entries.name: Destroying Sulfuras
entries: In an underwater tunnel network deep beneath Vashj'ir lies an abandoned, heavily trapped temple to Neptulon, the Elemental Lord of Water. Placing Sulfuras on the temple's central altar quenches its fire permanently, rendering it nonmagical and destructible.

name: Talbuk
entries: Use the {@creature Elk|XMM} stat block.

name: Troll's Blood Elixir
entries: When you drink this potion, you regain 2 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. At the start of each of your turns for the next 1 minute, you regain that number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} again if you have at least 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point}. This thick green elixir is made from herbs.
No trolls were harmed in the making of this elixir.

name: Troll's Blood Elixir (Greater)
entries: When you drink this potion, you regain 4 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. At the start of each of your turns for the next 1 minute, you regain that number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} again if you have at least 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point}. This thick green elixir is made from herbs.
No trolls were harmed in the making of this elixir.

name: Troll's Blood Elixir (Superior)
entries: When you drink this potion, you regain 6 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. At the start of each of your turns for the next 1 minute, you regain that number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} again if you have at least 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point}. This thick green elixir is made from herbs.
No trolls were harmed in the making of this elixir.

name: Troll's Blood Elixir (Supreme)
entries: When you drink this potion, you regain 8 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. At the start of each of your turns for the next 1 minute, you regain that number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} again if you have at least 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point}. This thick green elixir is made from herbs.
No trolls were harmed in the making of this elixir.

name: Twin Blades of Azzinoth
entries: This pair of demonic warglaives once belonged to Azzinoth, an ancient doomguard commander of the Burning Legion. {@creature Illidan Stormrage|WoW} slew Azzinoth millennia ago during the War of the Ancients and reforged the blades for himself, allowing him to use fel magic against the demons of the Legion.

entries.name: Magic Weapons
entries: You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with these magic weapons. Each deals an extra {@damage 2d8} Psychic damage if the target is a Fiend; this Psychic damage ignores {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB}.

entries.name: Fel Synchronization
entries: If you hit the same creature with both weapons on a turn, that creature makes a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw immediately after the second weapon hits. On a failed save, the creature is racked by fel magic and has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Flames of Azzinoth
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can throw one of the weapons to an unoccupied space on the ground you can see within 30 feet of you. The blade transforms into a fiery green fiend as if you had cast the {@spell Summon Fiend|XPHB} spell (choose the Devil option). The spell lasts for 1 minute, and when the summoned fiend disappears, the weapon reappears in your hand. You can't turn that weapon into a Fiend again until 7 days have passed.

entries.name: Random Properties
entries: The Twin Blades of Azzinoth have the following random properties:

items: 1 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|XDMG|minor beneficial} property
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Major Beneficial Properties|XDMG|major beneficial} property
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|XDMG|minor detrimental} property

entries.name: Destroying the Blades
entries: Reciting an ancient poem called "Gift of the Light" over the blades causes them to dissolve into glittering dust. This poem has largely been lost to time, but a few rare naaru remember it.

name: Vithrak, Gaze of the Deadman
entries: This ring has 3 charges and regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the ring, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action and expend 1 charge to learn the {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|Resistances}, {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB|Vulnerabilities}, and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB|Immunities} (if any) of a creature you can see within 120 feet of yourself. When you use this effect, your eyes briefly become glassy, gray husks.

name: Warhorse
entries: Use the {@creature Warhorse|XMM} stat block.
{@b Prerequisite:} Renown 10+ with {@book Stormwind|WoW|4|Stormwind Renown Perks}.

name: Warhorse Skeleton
entries: Use the {@creature Warhorse Skeleton|XMM} stat block.
{@b Prerequisite:} Renown 10+ with {@book Undercity|WoW|4|Undercity Renown Perks}.

name: Wind Rider
entries: Use the {@creature Giant Bat|XMM} stat block.
{@b Prerequisite:} Renown 25+ with the {@book Horde|WoW|4|Horde Renown Perks}.

name: Zhevra
entries: Use the {@creature Elk|XMM} stat block.
